description: A comma on the line after an object element is an error
notes: The grammar allows a comma or a newline between elements but not both, while the prose says newlines between the braces are ignored as whitespace and has priority, so the newline before the comma shouldn't matter. hashicorp/hcl takes the newline as the separator and then rejects the comma where the next key should start (parseObjectCons in hclsyntax/parser.go).
